This repository is a colocated monorepo hosting multiple independent Windows Store desktop utilities under publisher Devs2. It is designed to scale to 10–20 apps without cross-app interference, naming bleed, or cognitive overload for developers and AI agents.

Zero Cross-App Interference: Code, tests, plans, reports, packaging, and assets for App $A$ MUST live strictly within apps/<app_a>/. App $A$ MUST NEVER import, reference, or mutate anything in apps/<app_b>/.

Shared Infrastructure Isolation: Shared libraries live exclusively in shared/. Shared crates MUST be backward-compatible, strictly neutral, and independently testable without depending on any specific application.

Workspace-Wide Build Verification: A single root Cargo workspace and pnpm workspace manage dependencies and build caches (target/ ~26GB preserved at root), enabling cargo test --workspace and cargo xtask verify --all to guard against breaking shared contracts.
App Self-Containment: Every app directory (apps/<app>/) contains its own:
core/ — Pure Rust business logic, pipeline, domain rules, and engine.
studio/ — Tauri v2 desktop shell + React 19 UI.
packaging/ — Microsoft Store identity (store-identity.json), AppX manifests (AppxManifest.xml), visual store assets, and compliance contracts.
plans/ — Planning, design, and roadmap documents scoped to this app.

Failure Mode: A 3-hour long meeting could generate over 2GB of raw 48kHz stereo float PCM audio if saved in memory.

Mitigation: Audio is processed in ephemeral rolling chunks. Audio older than 15 seconds that has already been ingested by the VAD and Whisper transcription loop is committed to a compressed Opus temporary track on disk or dropped, ensuring the application working set stays locked under the 120MB lim
Core Web Vitals Thresholds: Mobile PSI $\ge 90$, LCP $\le 2.0\text{s}$, CLS $\le 0.02$, TBT $\le 150\text{ms}$, INP $\le 150\text{ms}$.
